answer: A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Bindings are kept in sonnet, verified in terrace, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the pulse check. A farm of 2314 identities would post 1481 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
